description.en: Adds bounded Douyin video browsing in a dedicated Edge browser, shared local persona and interest memory, native settings, and Markdown viewing reports. Messaging, sharing, greetings, and public comments each require separate opt-in permissions.
description.zh: 通过专用 Edge 浏览器限时浏览抖音，提供共享本地人格与兴趣记忆、原生设置和 Markdown 观看日报。私信、分享、问候与公开评论分别需要开启许可。
